assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, quadriceps muscle, mouse (C57BL/6), HTSeq gene counts (GEO data_processing)
primary_estimand: Transcriptome effect of skeletal-muscle Nampt genotype (knockout or overexpression) and of age on quadriceps gene expression. Exercise is used only as a phenotypic readout (treadmill tolerance tests, S2.1.p3, S2.2.p2, S2.4.p1), never as an intervention whose transcriptional effect is measured.
planned_contrasts: mNKO vs WT at 7 months (S2.2.p3; paper: 33% of detectable genes significant, Table S1)
mNTG vs WT at 24 months (S2.4.p1; paper: 18 genes, Table S2, FIG7 F)
WT 24m vs WT 4m and mNTG 24m vs mNTG 4m age effects (S2.4.p1; 87 overlapping genes, FIG7 G-H)
mNTG vs WT at 4 months (GEO supplementary DESeq table only)
exercise_arm: none: no RNA-seq sample is labelled exercised/trained vs sedentary; treatment_protocol_ch1 says mice were only 'occasionally subjected to glucose and exercise tolerance tests before sacrifice' (applies to all groups alike)
inclusion: 23 GSM samples: WT 7m (4), mNKO 7m (4), WT 4m (4), mNTG 4m (3), WT 24m (4), mNTG 24m (4)
paper_method: DESeq2 (GEO data_processing; RNA-seq statistics in Supplemental Information, not available here)

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG7 (Padj); exact rule in Supplemental Information not available
paper_threshold.note: FIG7 legend marks significance by Padj; S2.4.p1 mentions 'relaxed selection criteria' without stating them
